text: Use the defineModel() macro in the child (Vue 3.4+)
the compiler expands it to a modelValue prop and an update:modelValue event that is emitted when the local ref is mutated.
No: computed getters must be free of side effects such as async requests
use a watcher (watch), which runs a callback with side effects when reactive state changes.
Use the v-html directive, since mustaches render plain text
rendering untrusted HTML enables XSS, so only use v-html on content known to be safe.
Yes: export a reactive() object from a module and import it in each component
with SSR this singleton store is shared across requests, which causes cross-request state pollution.

defineAsyncComponent accepts a loadingComponent option, but async components are suspensible: inside <Suspense> their own loading, error, delay and timeout options are ignored and the Suspense #fallback slot is shown, unless suspensible: false is set.
Reactive props destructure is supported from Vue 3.5 on.
Name composables in camelCase starting with "use", e.g. useMouse.
